correction: Enforced Secure Boot was assumed to raise kernel lockdown automatically; the linux-surface kernel is built with CONFIG_LOCK_DOWN_KERNEL_FORCE_NONE=y and carries no Secure-Boot-to-lockdown wiring, so lockdown must be requested explicitly with the lockdown=integrity kernel command line.
evidence: grep 'LOCK_DOWN' on boot/config-*-surface-* in linux-image-surface; KernelCommandLine=lockdown=integrity in shared/native-ab-secure/mkosi.conf
